pairs.target: lín zhào xiān bǎ nà kuài bù liúzài le shēnshàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao first kept that piece of cloth against her body.
pairs.hanzi: 林照先把那块布留在了身上。

pairs.target: tā yìshǒu yā zhe shāngchù , mànmàn nuókāi bèi , cóng yāodài shàngjiě xià yuánxiān shù zài yāojiān de bùdài .
pairs.english: Keeping one hand pressed on the wound, she slowly moved her back away and untied from the waist pouch the cloth belt originally fastened around her waist.
pairs.hanzi: 她一手压着伤处，慢慢挪开背，从腰袋上解下原先束在腰间的布带。

pairs.target: bùdài bèi shuǐpào ruǎn le , rào huílái shí zǒng wǎng xiàhuá , tā biàn jiāng yījīn lǒng zhù , gé zhe yīfu , bǎ zhé hòu de bù yā zài lǐmiàn .
pairs.english: Soaked soft by the water, the belt kept slipping down as she brought it around; she then drew her lapels together and held the thickly folded cloth inside, through the clothing.
pairs.hanzi: 布带被水泡软了，绕回来时总往下滑，她便将衣襟拢住，隔着衣服，把折厚的布压在里面。

pairs.target: jié dǎ zài shēn qián .
pairs.english: She tied the knot in front.
pairs.hanzi: 结打在身前。

pairs.target: tā yòng yá yǎozhù yìtóu , lìngyìzhī shǒu yìdiǎndiǎn shōujǐn , shōudào yāo cè fā téng , biàn bùgǎn zài lēi .
pairs.english: She gripped one end in her teeth and tightened it bit by bit with her other hand; when her side began to hurt, she dared pull no tighter.
pairs.hanzi: 她用牙咬住一头，另一只手一点点收紧，收到腰侧发疼，便不敢再勒。

pairs.target: bù méi wǎngxiàdiào , tā bǎshǒu sōngkāi piànkè , yòu gǎnjǐn àn huíqù .
pairs.english: The cloth didn't slip down; she released her hand a moment, then quickly pressed it back.
pairs.hanzi: 布没往下掉，她把手松开片刻，又赶紧按回去。

pairs.target: hái zài .
pairs.english: Still there.
pairs.hanzi: 还在。

pairs.target: tā jiāng yāodài hé shuǐnáng de jìshéng guàhuí bùdài , shì zhe chēng qǐshēn , méi chēngzhù , zhǐhǎo zuò huí yuánchù .
pairs.english: She hung the pouch and the waterskin’s cord back on the belt and tried pushing herself upright, but couldn’t hold herself up and had to sit back where she was.
pairs.hanzi: 她将腰袋和水囊的系绳挂回布带，试着撑起身，没撑住，只好坐回原处。

pairs.target: shítou liáng dé wǎng gǔtou lǐ zuàn , shī kùtuǐ tiēzhe xīwō , dǒu yízhèn , biàn yǒu yízhèn shuōbùchū de kōng .
pairs.english: Cold bored from the stone deep into her bones; wet trouser legs clung behind her knees, and each bout of trembling left a spell of indescribable hollowness.
pairs.hanzi: 石头凉得往骨头里钻，湿裤腿贴着膝窝，抖一阵，便有一阵说不出的空。

pairs.target: tā chī le yìxiǎo kǒu bǐng , jiáo le hěn jiǔ , cái jiù shuǐ yànxià .
pairs.english: She ate a small bite of flatbread, chewed for a long time, then swallowed it with water.
pairs.hanzi: 她吃了一小口饼，嚼了很久，才就水咽下。

pairs.target: shuǐdào wǎngqián wān qù , qiánggēn de shíkǎn hái lián zhe , kuān yì jié , zhǎi yì jié .
pairs.english: The channel curved ahead; the shelf at the wall’s foot still continued, wider for one stretch, narrower for another.
pairs.hanzi: 水道往前弯去，墙根的石坎还连着，宽一截，窄一截。

pairs.target: liǎngsānbù wài , shídǐng quē le yìjiǎo , dǐxià yǒu kuài shāokuān de shí miàn , jīshuǐ cóng wàiyán liúguò , lǐmiàn kànzhe shì gān de .
pairs.english: Two or three paces away, a corner of the roof was missing, with a slightly wider stone surface below; water flowed along its outer rim, while the inside looked dry.
pairs.hanzi: 两三步外，石顶缺了一角，底下有块稍宽的石面，积水从外沿流过，里面看着是干的。

pairs.target: nàlǐ de guāng yě liàng xiē , huòxǔ néng bǎ tuǐ shēnkāi .
pairs.english: The light was brighter there too; perhaps she could stretch out her legs.
pairs.hanzi: 那里的光也亮些，或许能把腿伸开。

pairs.target: tā kàn le xǔjiǔ , xiān yòng jiǎo tàn le tànshēn qián de shí yán , zài bǎshǒu fàngdào qiánmiàn nà kuài gān shí shàng .
pairs.english: She watched for a long while, first feeling the ledge before her with a foot, then setting her hand on the dry stone ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 她看了许久，先用脚探了探身前的石沿，再把手放到前面那块干石上。

pairs.target: cái nuó guò bàngè shēnzi , yāo cè biàn xiàng bèi xìxiàn lēizhù .
pairs.english: Barely half her body had moved forward when her side felt as though cinched by a fine thread.
pairs.hanzi: 才挪过半个身子，腰侧便像被细线勒住。

pairs.target: tā tíngxiàlái , yìshǒu àn bù , yìshǒu dǐ zhe qiáng , děng nà gǔ téng huǎn guòqù .
pairs.english: She stopped, one hand pressing the cloth and the other braced against the wall, waiting for the pain to subside.
pairs.hanzi: 她停下来，一手按布，一手抵着墙，等那股疼缓过去。

pairs.target: bùdài méiyǒu sōng , zhǐtou dǐxià yě méi mō dào xīn de shī , tā cái jiēzhe wǎngqián .
pairs.english: The belt hadn’t loosened, and beneath her fingers there was no fresh wetness; only then did she continue forward.
pairs.hanzi: 布带没有松，指头底下也没摸到新的湿，她才接着往前。

pairs.target: zài wǎngqián yìdiǎn , shí yán bèi yíkuài báobǎn zhēzhù le .
pairs.english: A little farther, a thin slab covered the ledge.
pairs.hanzi: 再往前一点，石沿被一块薄板遮住了。

pairs.target: shíbǎn xié pù zhe , kàoqiáng de yìjiǎo dā zài jǐkuài suìshí shàng , wàitou nà yìbiān jìn zài shuǐ lǐ .
pairs.english: The slab lay at an angle, the corner by the wall propped on several broken stones, its outer edge immersed in the water.
pairs.hanzi: 石板斜铺着，靠墙的一角搭在几块碎石上，外头那一边浸在水里。

pairs.target: dǐxià liú zhe yídào kòngxì , hái kàndéjiàn yuánxiān de shí yán .
pairs.english: A gap remained beneath it; the original ledge was still visible.
pairs.hanzi: 底下留着一道空隙，还看得见原先的石沿。

pairs.target: tā bùgǎn wǎng wài cǎi , nàbiān de shuǐsè bǐ shēnhòu shēn , shítou de biān zài nǎlǐ , kànbùchūlái .
pairs.english: She dared not step outward; the water there was darker than behind her, and she couldn’t make out where the edge of the stone lay.
pairs.hanzi: 她不敢往外踩，那边的水色比身后深，石头的边在哪里，看不出来。

pairs.target: tā xiān shēnshǒu yā le yā lùchū de shí yán , méiyǒu sōng .
pairs.english: First she reached out and pressed the exposed ledge; it didn’t shift.
pairs.hanzi: 她先伸手压了压露出的石沿，没有松。

pairs.target: xīgài wǎngqián cèng shí , xié jiān biàn shùnzhe qiánggēn , tàn jìn bǎn jiǎo dǐxià .
pairs.english: As she edged her knee forward, her toe then followed the wall into the space beneath the slab’s corner.
pairs.hanzi: 膝盖往前蹭时，鞋尖便顺着墙根，探进板角底下。

pairs.target: yílì suìshí gǔn le chūqù .
pairs.english: A small stone rolled out.
pairs.hanzi: 一粒碎石滚了出去。

pairs.target: tā tīngjiàn qīngqīng de yìshēng pèng xiǎng , jiǎobèi suíjí yì jǐn .
pairs.english: She heard a faint clack, and then her instep tightened.
pairs.hanzi: 她听见轻轻的一声碰响，脚背随即一紧。

pairs.target: bǎn jiǎoluò xiàlái , yāzhù xiémiàn , bànbiān shēnzi hái méi gēnshàng , yāo yǐ xiān bèi zhuài dé fā téng .
pairs.english: The corner dropped, pinning her shoe; half her body had yet to follow, but her waist was already aching from the pull.
pairs.hanzi: 板角落下来，压住鞋面，半边身子还没跟上，腰已先被拽得发疼。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn tíngzhù .
pairs.english: She stopped at once.
pairs.hanzi: 她赶紧停住。

pairs.target: xiélǐ de jiǎozhǐ hái néngdòng .
pairs.english: Her toes could still move inside the shoe.
pairs.hanzi: 鞋里的脚趾还能动。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng zhào xiānqián nàyàng zhuǎn jiǎo , cái zhuǎn le yìdiǎn , xiémiàn biàn bēngjǐn le , téng yánzhe jiǎobèi cuàn shànglái .
pairs.english: She tried turning her foot the way she had before, but had barely begun when the shoe pulled taut and pain shot up her instep.
pairs.hanzi: 她想照先前那样转脚，才转了一点，鞋面便绷紧了，疼沿着脚背窜上来。

pairs.target: tā bùgǎn zài nǐng , zhǐnéng bǎ xīgài shōu jìn , shēnchū mò bāo bù de shǒu , mō dào bǎn jiǎo xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: She dared not twist any more, and could only draw her knee closer, reach out with her unbandaged hand and feel beneath the corner.
pairs.hanzi: 她不敢再拧，只能把膝盖收近，伸出没包布的手，摸到板角下面。

pairs.target: bǎn de wàiyán hái zhī zài shuǐxià de shítou shàng , tā zhī xū jiāng zhè yìjiǎo dǐng qǐ yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The outer edge was still supported on a stone beneath the water; she only needed to raise this one corner a little.
pairs.hanzi: 板的外沿还支在水下的石头上，她只需将这一角顶起一点。

pairs.target: tā qūqǐ gēbo , shǒuxīn cháo shàng , tiēzhù shíbǎn , wǎng shàng sòng .
pairs.english: She bent her arm, palm up, pressed against the slab and pushed upward.
pairs.hanzi: 她屈起胳膊，手心朝上，贴住石板，往上送。

pairs.target: bǎn jiǎo dòng le , xiémiàn sōng chū yíxiàn .
pairs.english: The corner moved, and a sliver of slack opened over her shoe.
pairs.hanzi: 板角动了，鞋面松出一线。

pairs.target: tā lìkè xiǎng shōujiǎo , yāo cè què téng dé yì ruǎn , shǒu xiān cóng bǎn xiàhuá le chūlái .
pairs.english: She immediately tried to draw her foot in, but pain in her side made her buckle, and her hand slipped out from beneath the slab first.
pairs.hanzi: 她立刻想收脚，腰侧却疼得一软，手先从板下滑了出来。

pairs.target: shítou chóngxīn yāxiàlái .
pairs.english: The stone pressed down again.
pairs.hanzi: 石头重新压下来。

pairs.target: tā méi rěnzhù , jiào le yìshēng , shēngyīn zài dī dǐng xià zhuàng dé yòu duǎn yòu jiān .
pairs.english: She couldn’t hold back a cry; beneath the low roof, it rang, both short and shrill.
pairs.hanzi: 她没忍住，叫了一声，声音在低顶下撞得又短又尖。

pairs.target: jiǎo wǎng wài chōu , xié què réng jiá zhe , shībù dài zài yāo shàng chě le yíxià .
pairs.english: She pulled her foot outward, but the shoe was still trapped; the wet belt tugged once at her waist.
pairs.hanzi: 脚往外抽，鞋却仍夹着，湿布带在腰上扯了一下。

pairs.target: bié zhuài .
pairs.english: Don't yank.
pairs.hanzi: 别拽。

pairs.target: yuè zhuài yuè jǐn .
pairs.english: The more she pulled, the tighter it grew.
pairs.hanzi: 越拽越紧。

pairs.target: tā bǎshǒu shōu zài xiōngqián , zhǐjiān hái quán zhe , xiǎng děng zhè zhèn téng guòqù zài tuī .
pairs.english: She drew her hand back to her chest, fingertips still curled, wanting to wait for the spell of pain to pass before pushing again.
pairs.hanzi: 她把手收在胸前，指尖还蜷着，想等这阵疼过去再推。

pairs.target: shuǐ yòu zuānjìn xiélǐ , bīng dé jiǎozhǐ yì suō .
pairs.english: Water seeped into her shoe again, cold enough to make her toes curl.
pairs.hanzi: 水又钻进鞋里，冰得脚趾一缩。

pairs.target: tā jí dé yòu wǎngqián tànshēn , zhǎngxīn méi pèngdào bǎn dǐ , yāo cè biàn téng dé yǎnqián yì hēi .
pairs.english: Desperation made her lean forward again, but before her palm reached the underside, pain in her side made her vision darken.
pairs.hanzi: 她急得又往前探身，掌心没碰到板底，腰侧便疼得眼前一黑。

pairs.target: tā suōhuí shǒu , zuàn zhù yījīn .
pairs.english: She drew back her hand and gripped her lapel.
pairs.hanzi: 她缩回手，攥住衣襟。

pairs.target: zài tuī yíxià .
pairs.english: One more push.
pairs.hanzi: 再推一下。

pairs.target: zhège niàntou hái mò luòxià , shíbǎn hūrán yòu tái le .
pairs.english: Before the thought had settled, the slab suddenly lifted again.
pairs.hanzi: 这个念头还没落下，石板忽然又抬了。

pairs.target: búshì tā de shǒu .
pairs.english: It wasn't her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 不是她的手。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn yì jié jí dàn de shǒubì , cóng zìjǐ fāngcái chēngguò de dìfāng táiqǐ lái .
pairs.english: She saw a barely visible arm rise from the place where she herself had just pushed.
pairs.hanzi: 她看见一截极淡的手臂，从自己方才撑过的地方抬起来。

pairs.target: shǒuxīn xiàngshàng , zhǐtou tiēzhe bǎn dǐ , wǎng shàng yí sòng , lián wànzǐ wāiguòqù de yàngzi dōu hé gāngcái yíyàng .
pairs.english: Palm up, fingers against the underside, it gave a push upward; even the wrist tilted in exactly the same way as before.
pairs.hanzi: 手心向上，指头贴着板底，往上一送，连腕子歪过去的样子都和刚才一样。

pairs.target: shítou dǐxià de ànyǐng jìng néng cóng nà céng lúnkuò lǐ tòuchūlái .
pairs.english: The darkness beneath the stone was actually visible through that outline.
pairs.hanzi: 石头底下的暗影竟能从那层轮廓里透出来。

pairs.target: xiémiàn sōng le .
pairs.english: The shoe loosened.
pairs.hanzi: 鞋面松了。

pairs.target: lín zhào měngdì shōu tuǐ , jiǎogēn kē zài qiánggēn , zhěngzhī xié zhōngyú tuì le chūlái .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao suddenly drew her leg back; her heel struck against the foot of the wall, and the whole shoe finally came free.
pairs.hanzi: 林照猛地收腿，脚跟磕在墙根，整只鞋终于退了出来。

pairs.target: bǎn jiǎo suíjí luòxià , pèng xiǎng tiēzhe tā de jiǎojiān , jiàn qǐ yìcéng shuǐ .
pairs.english: The corner dropped at once, clacking close to her toes and splashing up a sheet of water.
pairs.hanzi: 板角随即落下，碰响贴着她的脚尖，溅起一层水。

pairs.target: nà jié shǒubì yǐjīng bújiàn le .
pairs.english: The arm was already gone.
pairs.hanzi: 那截手臂已经不见了。

pairs.target: tā hái zuàn zhe zìjǐ de yījīn , shǒubèi tiē zài xiōngqián .
pairs.english: She was still gripping her own lapel, the back of her hand against her chest.
pairs.hanzi: 她还攥着自己的衣襟，手背贴在胸前。

pairs.target: lìngyìzhī shǒu zhèngyā zhe yāo cè de bù , liǎngzhī dōu zài shēnshàng .
pairs.english: Her other hand was pressing the cloth at her side; both hands were on her body.
pairs.hanzi: 另一只手正压着腰侧的布，两只都在身上。

pairs.target: tā dīng zhe bǎn dǐ , bàntiān méiyǒu dòng .
pairs.english: She stared beneath the slab and didn't move for a long time.
pairs.hanzi: 她盯着板底，半天没有动。

pairs.target: " shuí ? "
pairs.english: “Who?”

pairs.target: yìdīshuǐ cóng duàn dǐng luòxiàlái , dǎ zài tā xiùkǒu .
pairs.english: A drop of water fell from the broken roof and struck against her sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 一滴水从断顶落下来，打在她袖口。

pairs.target: tā wǎng shēnhòu kàn , nàlǐ zhǐyǒu zìjǐ pá guò de zhǎi shíkǎn , lián gěi rén zhàn de dìfāng dōu méiyǒu .
pairs.english: She looked behind her; there was only the narrow shelf she’d crawled along, with not even a place for anyone to stand.
pairs.hanzi: 她往身后看，那里只有自己爬过的窄石坎，连给人站的地方都没有。

pairs.target: tā mànmàn bǎ méi bāo bù de shǒu fānguòlái .
pairs.english: She slowly turned her unbandaged hand over.
pairs.hanzi: 她慢慢把没包布的手翻过来。

pairs.target: zhǎng gēn zhān zhe huī , jǐdào shí lì yāchū de xì yìn , hé fāngcái dǐngbǎn shí yíyàng .
pairs.english: Gray dust clung to the heel of her palm, with a few fine marks pressed by stone grit, just as when she’d pushed the slab before.
pairs.hanzi: 掌根沾着灰，几道石粒压出的细印，和方才顶板时一样。

pairs.target: tā shì zhe yòu xiàngshàng sòng le yíxià , miànqián shénme yě méiyǒu .
pairs.english: She tried another upward push, but there was nothing before her.
pairs.hanzi: 她试着又向上送了一下，面前什么也没有。

pairs.target: tā děng zhe , yǎnjīng dīng dé fāsuān , zhǐyǒu zhǐjiān zài dǒu .
pairs.english: She waited, staring until her eyes ached; only her fingertips trembled.
pairs.hanzi: 她等着，眼睛盯得发酸，只有指尖在抖。

pairs.target: gāngcái nà jié wànzǐ míngmíng yě shì zhèyàng wāi de .
pairs.english: That wrist had plainly tilted the same way a moment ago, too.
pairs.hanzi: 刚才那截腕子明明也是这样歪的。

pairs.target: tā zhāng le zhāngzuǐ , méi néng shuōchū huà lái .
pairs.english: She opened her mouth but couldn’t get any words out.
pairs.hanzi: 她张了张嘴，没能说出话来。

pairs.target: xiǎng zài wǎng bǎn xià kàn , jiǎozhǐ què pèngdào shīlěng de xiédǐ , tā lìjí jiāng jiǎo shōujǐn , dǐzhù qiáng .
pairs.english: She wanted to look beneath the slab again, but her toes touched the cold wet sole, and she immediately drew her foot in against the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 想再往板下看，脚趾却碰到湿冷的鞋底，她立即将脚收紧，抵住墙。

pairs.target: bùnéng zài shēnjìnqù .
pairs.english: She mustn't put it under there again.
pairs.hanzi: 不能再伸进去。

pairs.target: éjiǎo tūtū dì tiào , xiōngkǒu què shāo dé lìhài .
pairs.english: Her temple throbbed steadily, but her chest burned fiercely.
pairs.hanzi: 额角突突地跳，胸口却烧得厉害。

pairs.target: tā dītóu mōlemō bùdài , jié hái zài , shāngchù réng téng .
pairs.english: She lowered her head and felt the belt; the knot was still there and the wound still hurt.
pairs.hanzi: 她低头摸了摸布带，结还在，伤处仍疼。

pairs.target: nà yìdiǎn bùzhī cóng nǎlǐ lái de bāngshǒu , méiyǒu tì tā liúxià biéde dōngxī .
pairs.english: That little helper had come from who knew where, but had not left anything else for her.
pairs.hanzi: 那一点不知从哪里来的帮手，没有替她留下别的东西。

pairs.target: lín zhào fú zhe qiáng , bìkāi bǎn jiǎo , cóng lùchū de nèiyán mànmàn nuó guòqù .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao braced against the wall and slowly edged along the exposed inner lip, keeping clear of the corner.
pairs.hanzi: 林照扶着墙，避开板角，从露出的内沿慢慢挪过去。

pairs.target: nà kuài shāokuān de shí miàn bǐ tā xiānqián kànzhe hái yuǎn .
pairs.english: The slightly wider stone surface was even farther away than it had looked.
pairs.hanzi: 那块稍宽的石面比她先前看着还远。

pairs.target: tā pá yíduàn biàn dé tíngxià , dào le quē dǐng dǐxià , shǒubì yǐjīng chēngbúzhù , biàn cè zhe shēn kàoqiáng zuòxià , bǎ jiǎo yìdiǎndiǎn shēnzhí .
pairs.english: She had to stop after each short stretch of crawling; beneath the gap in the roof her arms could no longer support her, so she sat sideways against the wall and straightened her legs bit by bit.
pairs.hanzi: 她爬一段便得停下，到了缺顶底下，手臂已经撑不住，便侧着身靠墙坐下，把脚一点点伸直。

pairs.target: tā gé zhe xiémiàn mōlemō jiǎobèi , zhǒngqǐ de dìfāng yí pèng jiù téng .
pairs.english: She felt her instep through the shoe; the swollen spot hurt at a touch.
pairs.hanzi: 她隔着鞋面摸了摸脚背，肿起的地方一碰就疼。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu tuō , pà tuō xià jiù zài tào bù huíqù , zhī jiāng xiédài sōngkāi yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: She didn’t take it off, afraid that once off she wouldn’t get it back on; she only loosened the laces a little.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有脱，怕脱下就再套不回去，只将鞋带松开一点。

alignment.english: she wouldn’t get it back on

pairs.target: shuǐ cóng xié biān dīchūlái , luò zài shí shàng , jī chéng yìxiǎo wā .
pairs.english: Water dripped from the shoe's edge, fell onto the stone and gathered in a small puddle.
pairs.hanzi: 水从鞋边滴出来，落在石上，积成一小洼。

pairs.target: yāodài lǐ de bǐng hái zài .
pairs.english: The flatbread was still in the waist pouch.
pairs.hanzi: 腰袋里的饼还在。

pairs.target: shuǐnáng yě méi sōng .
pairs.english: The waterskin hadn't come loose either.
pairs.hanzi: 水囊也没松。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tāmen jiě xiàlái , fàngdào kàoqiáng de yìbiān , shǒu què chíchí méi cóng shuǐnáng shàngyí kāi .
pairs.english: She untied them and set them to one side by the wall, but for a long time her hand did not move away from the waterskin.
pairs.hanzi: 她把它们解下来，放到靠墙的一边，手却迟迟没从水囊上移开。

pairs.target: gé yíhuìer , tā biàn wǎnglái shí nà kuài shíbǎn kàn yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Every so often she would cast a glance toward the slab she’d come past.
pairs.hanzi: 隔一会儿，她便往来时那块石板看一眼。

pairs.target: shuǐ yìzhí cóng bǎnbiān liúguòqù .
pairs.english: Water kept flowing past the slab's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 水一直从板边流过去。

pairs.target: tā zhōngyú dīxiàtóu , jiāng liǎngzhīshǒu bìngpái fàngzài xī shàng .
pairs.english: At last she lowered her head and laid both hands side by side on her knees.
pairs.hanzi: 她终于低下头，将两只手并排放在膝上。

pairs.target: méiyǒu nǎyìzhī shǎo le , yě méiyǒu duō chūlái de .
pairs.english: Neither one was missing, and there wasn’t an extra one.
pairs.hanzi: 没有哪一只少了，也没有多出来的。
